heading: Here's a glimpse into my work — a taste of what I can bring

actions.codeNotAvailable: Source code not available - Private project

lunetterie-du-coin.title: La Lunetterie du Coin
lunetterie-du-coin.description: Modern showcase website for an independent optician, with integrated appointment booking and contact form.
lunetterie-du-coin.deliverables: Multi-page site, custom design system, Framer Motion animations, Formspree contact form, Calendly booking, full SEO, CI/CD pipeline, Sentry monitoring
lunetterie-du-coin.context: Give an independent optician a professional, high-performance web presence with a focus on accessibility, performance and bold maximalist design.

site-vitrine-avocate.title: Rayssa Eskinazi — Lawyer
site-vitrine-avocate.description: Professional showcase website for a Strasbourg-based lawyer, optimized for local SEO and converting visitors into booked appointments.
site-vitrine-avocate.deliverables: 13-page site, Formspree contact form, Calendly booking, local SEO with JSON-LD, responsive design, GDPR compliance, full test suite
site-vitrine-avocate.context: A practicing lawyer in Strasbourg needed a professional website to rank on local searches and make it easy for clients to book consultations.

luciole.title: Luciole — AI Agent
luciole.description: Conversational AI agent that automates tech intelligence: collects, analyzes and summarizes 200+ articles/day from 40+ RSS sources.
luciole.deliverables: ReAct agent with 8 tools, automated RSS ingestion pipeline, web interface with SSE streaming, custom RAG system, anti-injection security, Docker deployment
luciole.context: IT teams spend about 15 min per article on manual monitoring. This agent reduces that to seconds per query.

stella-ecommerce.title: Stella — E-commerce
stella-ecommerce.description: Full stack e-commerce application for browsing, filtering, and purchasing stars, with secure authentication, cart and review system.
stella-ecommerce.deliverables: Interactive catalog, JWT/CSRF authentication, cart and wishlist, order system, Swagger-documented RESTful API, admin panel, payment module
stella-ecommerce.context: Personal project built to demonstrate full stack skills in real-world conditions: MVC architecture, multi-layered security, ORM and automated testing.

tour-de-controle.title: Tour de Contrôle
tour-de-controle.description: Restaurant cash register and staff management web application, with transaction tracking and discrepancy detection.
tour-de-controle.deliverables: Swagger-documented REST API, full React interface, JWT authentication with RBAC, automatic cash discrepancy detection, staff CRUD, PostgreSQL with Sqitch migrations, Docker Compose 6 services
tour-de-controle.context: Addressing a real restaurant need: centralizing cash register and staff management into a single, reliable, and secure tool.
